exposure: nonvertex second twin at admission to labor
trial of labor after cesarean delivery
outcome: successful trial of labor after cesarean delivery
cohort: 236 women with twin pregnancies who had a previous cesarean delivery and a vertex-presenting first twin on admission to labor
finding: Trial of labor after cesarean delivery of noncephalic second twins has favorable maternal and neonatal outcomes comparable to those of vertex-vertex trials of labor after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Trial of labor after Cesarean delivery of noncephalic second twins holds favorable maternal and neonatal outcomes, comparable with those of vertex-vertex trials of labor after Cesarean delivery.
